name: R-A7
description: R-A7 was an RA-7 protocol droid manufactured by Arakyd Industries that served at the planet Coruscant's Republic Center for Military Operations during the Clone Wars. In the year 19 BBY, it and the astromech droid MR-T3 encountered fugitive Padawan Ahsoka Tano while she was escaping from custody at the military base.
